task: You are an adversarial code reviewer. Your job is to find real bugs in the pull request checked out in the cwd, not to praise it. The PR description is at .review/pr-body.md and the full diff (without generated files) is at .review/pr.diff. Read both first, then the touched files.

You are an adversarial code reviewer. Your job is to find real problems in the pull request checked out in the cwd, not to praise it. The PR description is at .review/pr-body.md and the diff is at .review/pr.diff. Focus on error handling and API compatibility.

You are an adversarial reviewer of a PR in a Go monorepo (worktree at cwd). The diff is at /tmp/pr.diff and the description at /tmp/pr-body.md. Read both first, then read the full current files under cli/pkg/commands/ that the diff touches. FOCUS: behaviour changes users would notice.

You are an adversarial reviewer of a PR in a Go monorepo (worktree at cwd). The diff is at /tmp/pr.diff and the description at /tmp/pr-body.md. Read both first, then the touched files under cli/pkg/commands/. Also read AGENTS.md at the repo root and check the change follows it.

You are an adversarial reviewer of a PR in a Go monorepo (worktree at cwd). The diff is at /tmp/pr.diff and the description at /tmp/pr-body.md. Read both first. FOCUS: documentation accuracy of the user-facing help text (Short/Long/Example strings) for the changed CLI commands.

You are independently verifying an analysis in a Go monorepo (cwd). Be skeptical; confirm or refute each claim with file:line evidence, and look for anything missed. Ticket context: the permissions model for a feature is moving from a legacy capability check to tag-based access.

You are reviewing a proposed plan for a small change in a Go monorepo (cwd is the repo root). You have read-only tools including a read-only `git` tool. Verify every factual claim in the plan against the code, find anything it misses, and give a verdict.

You are reviewing a proposed plan for a small change in a Go monorepo (cwd is the repo root). You have read-only tools. Verify every factual claim against the code, find anything the plan misses or gets wrong, and give a verdict. Be concise and specific, citing file:line.
Add a --json flag to the herdr find plugin that prints matches as JSON lines instead of opening the picker.
Write a Go function that parses RFC 3339 durations from our config file and returns a time.Duration, with errors that name the offending key.
Propose a patch that adds exponential backoff with jitter to the retry loop in pkg/client/retry.go. Show the full diff.
Implement a TypeScript helper that truncates a string to N UTF-8 bytes without splitting a multi-byte character.
Port the fzf-style smart-case matching from the Rust picker to our Go picker package.
Add a /subagent-cancel command that takes an optional job number and aborts that job.
Write the nix home-manager module that starts a launchd agent for the router service on macOS.
Create a CLI subcommand `mycli images tags list` that prints tags for a repo, following the existing command patterns.
Tests in runner.test.ts hang forever on CI but pass locally. Figure out why.
mycli auth login panics with 'nil pointer dereference' in pkg/auth/token.go:142 after the last upgrade. Find the root cause.
The waybar clock module stopped updating after I switched to sway 1.10. What is causing it?
Why does `go test ./...` fail with 'import cycle not allowed' after moving the config package?
Users report the picker sometimes selects the wrong row after filtering. Reproduce and locate the bug.
Our API returns 502 intermittently under load; logs show 'context deadline exceeded' in the gRPC client. Diagnose it.
Neovim LSP attaches twice to Go buffers since I changed my lspconfig setup. Find out why.
The subagent status line keeps showing a job after it finished. Track down where the cleanup is missed.
Review src/auth.ts for security problems.
Look over this diff to the git policy and tell me if any write subcommand can slip through.
Check PR #812 for correctness issues and missing error handling before I approve it.
Critique the concurrency in pkg/cache/lru.go; are there data races?
Should the router run as one Python service with two backends or two separate services? Weigh the tradeoffs.
Design how we should store per-tenant rate limits so they survive restarts and scale to 10k tenants.
Compare using SQLite versus a JSONL log for recording routing decisions, given we need simple offline analysis.
Plan the migration of the image builder from the legacy capability model to tag-based access, across the API, IAM, and CLI.
What is the cleanest way to split herdrkit so plugins can share the picker without pulling in the terminal UI?
Propose an architecture for caching Hugging Face models across dev machines without committing weights to git.
We need to add multi-region failover to the registry. Outline the options and recommend one.
Evaluate whether the vi-mode extension should keep its own engine or build on the editor's keymap system.
Where is the subagent concurrency limit enforced?
Explain how the herdr plugin loader discovers and starts plugins.
Summarize what each file in pi/extensions/vi-mode does.
Find every place in the CLI that reads MYCLI_CONFIG.
How does the IAM service decide whether a role binding applies to a repo? Walk me through the code path.
List the nix modules imported by the Toms-Work-MacBook-Pro host and what each one provides.
What does git-policy.ts do with `branch` arguments?
Give me an overview of how sessions are stored under ~/.pi/agent/sessions.
Write table-driven tests for the git policy covering every rejected option.
What test cases are missing for the retry logic in pkg/client/retry.go?
Design an integration test for the router service that doesn't download real models.
Add unit tests for the UTF-8 truncation helper, including emoji and combining characters.
Our picker model has no tests for scrolling. Propose a set of tests.
Write a fuzz test for the RFC 3339 duration parser.
Check which branches of token.go are not exercised by the current test suite.
Write tests for /subagent-cancel with and without a job number.
Draft a friendly email to the team announcing the offsite dates.
What's a good recipe for dinner tonight with chickpeas and spinach?
Summarize the plot of the book Project Hail Mary.
Translate this paragraph into Spanish: The meeting has moved to Thursday.
